name: Moontouched Wildkin
summary: Erelas Ambersky asks you to gather Moontouched Feathers in Winterspring. You are to bring them back to Rut'theran Village.

sections.title: A Return to Erelas
sections.body: Erelas Ambersky waits in Rut'theran Village for what you bring back from Winterspring. Gather ten Moontouched Feathers there, then return to him with them.

faq.answer: Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village asks you to gather Moontouched Feathers.

faq.q: Where do I find Moontouched Feathers?
faq.answer: The Moontouched Feathers are to be collected from Winterspring.

faq.q: How many feathers does Erelas want?
faq.answer: Erelas asks you to collect ten Moontouched Feathers.

faq.q: Where do I take the feathers?
faq.answer: Bring the Moontouched Feathers back to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
